name: Cashew nuts
summary: Cashew nuts, one of the things the island is known for, sold at the Dinh Cậu night market to carry home.
origin: Phu Quoc, on the night account.
howToEat: Buy a bag at the night market.
where: The Dinh Cậu night market, where the streets close to traffic from 5 pm until midnight.
seoTitle: Cashew nuts at the Dinh Cau night market
seoDescription: Cashew nuts are one of the foods Phu Quoc is known for. Buy them at the Dinh Cậu night market.
